THE OPPORTUNITY

Big ideas don't
have a barrier.

BuildHer Bharat 2026 is a free girls-only innovation hackathon in India for school students, college and university students, and women working professionals.

See who can participate →

Organised by Shenfinity, sponsored and supported by the Hacknfinity Ecosystem, and featuring the Centre of Excellence – Cloud Computing, K.R. Mangalam University as a key institutional collaborator.

With SheKunj as Platform Partner & Sponsor and UpToSkills as Platform & Hiring Partner, the hackathon brings together ideas, mentorship and opportunity. Participants move through idea submission, online mentoring and prototype development, and an offline Grand Finale.

✦ Idea submission✦ Online mentorship✦ Prototype building✦ Offline pitching

GOOD QUESTIONS

Frequently
asked questions.

Need more information? Join the official participants' group for announcements and instructions.

Join WhatsApp group ↗
Who can participate?

School students, college and university students, and working professionals who are girls or women can participate.

Is registration free?

Yes. Registration for BuildHer Bharat 2026 is 100% free.

How many rounds are there?

There are three rounds: online idea submission, online mentoring and prototype development, and the offline Grand Finale.

Can participants from different institutions form a team?

Cross-institution and team-based participation is encouraged. Final team-composition instructions will be shared by the organisers.

Will participants receive certificates or internships?

Participation certificates, internship opportunities, and goodies are subject to event requirements, selection criteria, and announcements by the organisers.

How will we receive updates?

Join the official WhatsApp participants' group. Organisers will share announcements, reminders, submission instructions, mentoring details, and schedule updates there.

What should the Round 1 idea deck include?

Describe the problem, proposed solution, what makes it innovative, how it can be built, and the impact you expect it to create.

How will finalist projects be evaluated?

Projects may be assessed on innovation, relevance, execution, feasibility, impact, presentation and the jury Q&A.

What should teams know before submitting?

Submit original work, acknowledge any third-party resources you use, and follow the final instructions shared by the organisers.
